description: This file contains unit tests for the VoicePushToTalkHotkey class, specifically testing that begin and end actions fire once per key hold event. It defines a Counter actor for tracking calls and a test function to verify correct behavior.

classes.name: Counter
classes.description: An actor that tracks the number of times begin and end actions are triggered during hotkey events.

classes.name: VoicePushToTalkHotkey
classes.description: A class representing the hotkey, used in testing the start and end firing behavior.

methods.name: incBegin
methods.description: Increments the count of begin events.

methods.name: incEnd
methods.description: Increments the count of end events.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Returns current counts of began and ended events.

methods.name: begin end fires once per hold
methods.description: Test method to verify that the hotkey triggers begin and end actions exactly once per key hold cycle.
